reason: Charging-time descriptor: observed active constant-current duration summarizes charging progression under the recorded protocol.
limitation: Depends on charge current, starting voltage/SOC, protocol and data completeness; not a direct measurement of irreversible degradation.
selection_evidence: Member of historical F3 compact set selected by mean validation RMSE over seeds 42/123/2026, Vanilla LSTM, length 5, matched cohort.

reason: Taper-time descriptor: duration of the verified constant-voltage phase captures charging-current taper behavior not represented by CC duration alone.
limitation: Sensitive to termination current, CV identification and sparse logging; comparisons require compatible charging protocols.
selection_evidence: Member of historical F3 compact set selected by mean validation RMSE over seeds 42/123/2026, Vanilla LSTM, length 5, matched cohort.

reason: Curve-slope descriptor: the maximum smoothed dV/dQ on the established 3.8-4.0 V partial-capacity interval summarizes charging-curve shape.
limitation: Numerical differentiation is smoothing/grid sensitive; the peak is not assigned to a unique electrochemical mechanism.
selection_evidence: Member of historical F3 compact set selected by mean validation RMSE over seeds 42/123/2026, Vanilla LSTM, length 5, matched cohort.

reason: Peak-position descriptor: the voltage of the largest reliable interior dQ/dV peak captures horizontal changes in charging-curve morphology.
limitation: Only reliable interior peaks are accepted; rate, sensor offset, smoothing and interval coverage can affect the value.
selection_evidence: Member of historical F3 compact set selected by mean validation RMSE over seeds 42/123/2026, Vanilla LSTM, length 5, matched cohort.

reason: Peak-breadth descriptor: width at half prominence describes the spread of the selected IC peak beyond its location.
complementary_information: Peak shape and breadth, distinct from peak voltage.
limitation: Requires resolved peak flanks and full interval coverage; half-prominence width is not necessarily the same as width at half absolute height.
selection_evidence: Member of historical F3 compact set selected by mean validation RMSE over seeds 42/123/2026, Vanilla LSTM, length 5, matched cohort.
